correctness.rationale: Each theta parity class is described by branch subsets modulo complement, with exact h0 formula. An odd power has d odd length-e cycles, e divisible by 8. First type has \(2^d\) central anti-fixed complement pairs; second has \(2\sum_{j=0}^{(d-1)/2}\binom dj=2^d\) stable lower subsets, all parity even. Even powers give identical branch cycle types. Existence of irreducible polynomials of each degree and two distinct rational roots yields smooth curves over every odd q. Enumerations for g=4,8 and symbolic checks for g<=40 independently reproduced the claim; the all-g proof is non-computational.
